rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary of press reports (secondary; official text not retrieved): the electronic signature law was approved by Congress under Decreto 149-2013 on 30 July 2013; a 2020 reform of art. 27 recognizes foreign electronic signatures and certificates meeting an equivalent reliability standard; Banco Central de Honduras was authorized as certification provider.
